svg.title: Buck Converter simulation
svg.desc: Simulation over 20 milliseconds. Panels show inductor current in amperes and output voltage in volts. Mode shading identifies Switch on, Switch off, and Zero current. Dashed voltage thresholds command switching but do not bound the output: voltage continues rising after switch-off. Twenty events span seven switching cycles and all three modes; the direct Switch off to Switch on edge is not taken in this run. The diode blocks reverse current during zero-current periods. Numerical boundary corrections are not physical impulses.
